items.title: Two weeks ago I kicked off a loop to move OpenClaw's Lit-based Web frontend to Solid 2.0.  Took ~6 d…
items.summary: Peter Steinberger分享：两周前启动一个agent loop把OpenClaw的Web前端从Lit迁移到Solid 2.0，6天后完成Lit的移除，又花一周把代码模式迁移成Solid风格的写法，全程基本是自动的，他只是每隔一天查看一次进度，总共跑了约600个PR。结果是JS和CSS体积更小，更新颗粒度更精细，整体响应更跟手。

items.title: Moved to tsrs over the weekend. Drop-in replacement. Around 5x faster for OC.  Kind of amazing that…
